public_rationale: The contract reads the claim plainly: AI image generation in mid-2025 is much better than in 2022, and a sharp rider on a correctly built wheel with spokes and pedals was beyond what 2022 tools reliably produced. It does not read 'no model could' as a literal claim about every possible 2022 output. In August 2022, CyclingTips tested Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, DreamStudio, Craiyon and Enstil on cycling prompts (e1). It judged most of the resulting images 'a pretty decisive no' for professional use. It also found some impressive artistic results, mainly from Midjourney (e1). On the GenEval benchmark, which checks whether images match the objects, counts and positions in a prompt, Stable Diffusion v1.5, a 2022 model, scores 0.43 overall (e2). A 2025 study reports that GPT-4o's image generator scores 0.84 on the same benchmark, about double (e3). Together, these support a large improvement from 2022 to 2025. They do not show that no 2022 model could ever produce such an image.
limitations: The evidence does not show that no 2022 model could produce a sharp, mechanically correct image of a rider. The 2022 test found some good outputs.
GenEval measures whether images match the prompt, not sharpness or 'graphics' as such.
DALL-E 2, which the 2022 test called the gold standard, was not part of that test.
The ChatGPT-5 Thinking image described in the post was not independently inspected. The 2025 benchmark score is for GPT-4o's image generator.

our_interpretation: Plain reading: AI image generation in mid-2025 is much better than in 2022. The 2022 tools generally could not produce a clean, sharp picture of a person on a correctly built wheel with spokes and pedals.

The absolute 'no model could' is read as ordinary emphasis that this was beyond what 2022 tools reliably did. It is not read as a literal claim that no single 2022 sample could ever have looked like this.
The period runs from 2022 to the post date, because the claim compares the two.
criteria.support_condition: Sources showing that 2022 image tools mostly produced mangled or unusable bicycle and rider images, and that 2025 systems score far higher on measures of image quality or prompt accuracy.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Documented 2022 outputs or benchmarks showing that 2022 models routinely produced sharp, mechanically correct images of riders on cycles, or showing no large quality gap between 2022 and 2025 models.
